The absolute value is rounded half away from zero\n// once, from the exact rational value. A negative value that rounds to zero carries no sign.\nfunc Format(r *big.Rat) string {\n\tabs := new(big.Rat).Abs(r)\n\n\t// floor(abs*100 + 1/2) equals floor((200*num + den) / (2*den)) for non-negative abs.\n\tnum := new(big.Int).Mul(abs.Num(), big.NewInt(200))\n\tnum.Add(num, abs.Denom())\n\tden := new(big.Int).Mul(abs.Denom(), big.NewInt(2))\n\thundredths := num.Quo(num, den)\n\n\twhole, frac := new(big.Int).QuoRem(hundredths, big.NewInt(100), new(big.Int))\n\tsign := \"\"\n\tif r.Sign() < 0 && hundredths.Sign() != 0 {\n\t\tsign = \"-\"\n\t}\n\treturn fmt.Sprintf(\"%s%s.%02d\", sign, whole.String(), frac)\n}\n\n// Whole writes an integral r as a plain integer with no decimal point.\nfunc Whole(r *big.Rat) string {\n\treturn r.Num().String()\n}\n"}}}

string\n}\n\n// Fields returns the row in Header order.\nfunc (r Row) Fields() []string {\n\treturn IsNull reports whether a trimmed value is a null spelling: empty, or NA, N/A, or NULL ignoring case.\nfunc IsNull(v string) bool {\n\tswitch strings.ToUpper(v) {\n\tcase \"\", \"NA\", \"N/A\", \"NULL\":\n\t\treturn true\n\t}\n\treturn false\n}\n\n// Summarize computes the profile row for one column from its trimmed values in file order.\nfunc Summarize(name string, values []string) Row {\n\trow := Row{Column: name, Rows: len(values)}\n\tpresent := make([]string, 0, len(values))\n\tdistinct := make(map[string]struct{})\n\tfor _, v := range values {\n\t\tif IsNull(v) {\n\t\t\trow.Nulls++\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tpresent = append(present, v)\n\t\tdistinct[v] = struct{}{}\n\t}\n\trow.Distinct = len(distinct)\n\trow.Type = inferType(present)\n\n\tswitch row.Type {\n\tcase typeInteger, typeNumber:\n\t\tsummarizeNumeric(&row, present)\n\tcase typeDate, typeText:\n\t\tsummarizeText(&row, present)\n\tcase typeBoolean:\n\t\tsummarizeBoolean(&row, present)\n\t}\n\treturn row\n}\n\n// summarizeNumeric fills min, max, sum, mean, and median for an integer or number column.\n// Every value is parsed exactly; inferType admitted only decimal literals, so parsing cannot fail.\nfunc summarizeNumeric(row *Row, present []string) {\n\tvalues := make([]*big.Rat, len(present))\n\tfor i, v := range present {\n\t\tvalues[i], _ = new(big.Rat).SetString(v)\n\t}\n\n\tsorted := append([]*big.Rat(nil), values...)\n\tsort.Slice(sorted, func(i, j int) bool { return sorted[i].Cmp(sorted[j]) < 0 })\n\tn := len(sorted)\n\n\tsum := new(big.Rat)\n\tfor _, v := range values {\n\t\tsum.Add(sum, v)\n\t}\n\tmean := new(big.Rat).Quo(sum, new(big.Rat).SetInt64(int64(n)))\n\n\tvar median *big.Rat\n\tif n%2 == 1 {\n\t\tmedian = sorted[n/2]\n\t} else {\n\t\tmedian = new(big.Rat).Add(sorted[n/2-1], sorted[n/2])\n\t\tmedian.Quo(median, big.NewRat(2, 1))\n\t}\n\n\tformat := decimal.Format\n\tif row.Type == typeInteger {\n\t\tformat = decimal.Whole\n\t\trow.Sum = decimal.Whole(sum)\n\t} else {\n\t\trow.Sum = decimal.Format(sum)\n\t}\n\trow.Min = format(sorted[0])\n\trow.Max = format(sorted[n-1])\n\trow.Mean = decimal.Format(mean)\n\trow.Median = decimal.Format(median)\n}\n\n// summarizeText fills min and max by byte value for a date or text column.\nfunc summarizeText(row *Row, present []string) {\n\trow.Min, row.Max = present[0], present[0]\n\tfor _, v := range present[1:] {\n\t\tif v < row.Min {\n\t\t\trow.Min = v\n\t\t}\n\t\tif v > row.Max {\n\t\t\trow.Max = v\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\n// summarizeBoolean fills min and max for a boolean column, in lower case.\nfunc summarizeBoolean(row *Row, present []string) {\n\tanyFalse, anyTrue := false, false\n\tfor _, v := range present {\n\t\tif strings.ToLower(v) == \"true\" {\n\t\t\tanyTrue = true\n\t\t} else {\n\t\t\tanyFalse = true\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\trow.Min = \"true\"\n\tif anyFalse {\n\t\trow.Min = \"false\"\n\t}\n\trow.Max = Values with equal\n// counts are ordered ascending by byte value. Null values are never listed.\nfunc Frequencies(values []string, top int) []Count {\n\tcounts := make(map[string]int)\n\tfor _, v := range values {\n\t\tif !IsNull(v) {\n\t\t\tcounts[v]++\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\tout := make([]Count, 0, len(counts))\n\tfor v, n := range counts {\n\t\tout = append(out, Count{Value: v, Count: n})\n\t}\n\tsort.Slice(out, func(i, j int) bool {\n\t\tif out[i].Count != out[j].Count {\n\t\t\treturn out[i].Count > out[j].Count\n\t\t}\n\t\treturn out[i].Value < out[j].Value\n\t})\n\tif len(out) > top {\n\t\tout = out[:top]\n\t}\n\treturn out\n}\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false},"tool_result_meta":[{"id":"toolu_01G1nVUEhFxBBSCaE2zFvUEh","permission_decision":{"decision":"accept","source":"config","reason_type":"mode"}}]}

{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-haiku-5-5","id":"msg_011CgN1x644oVPN47c32h9Rw","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_0167Uh12t49vLh42YuKcHdXc","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/mnt/c/Users/barlo/projects/drydock/uat/CsvStat/runs/20261025.001433/build/CsvStat/internal/csvio/csvio_test.go","content":"package csvio\n\nimport (\n\t\"errors\"\n\t\"os\"\n\t\"path/filepath\"\n\t\"reflect\"\n\t\"testing\"\n)\n\n// writeFile stores content in a fresh temporary file and returns its path.\nfunc writeFile(t *testing.T, content string) string {\n\tt.Helper()\n\tpath := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), \"in.csv\")\n\tif err := os.WriteFile(path, []byte(content), 0o644); err != nil {\n\t\tt.Fatal(err)\n\t}\n\treturn path\n}\n\n// loadRejected loads content and asserts it is rejected with a RejectError, returning that error.\nfunc loadRejected(t *testing.T, content string) *RejectError {\n\tt.Helper()\n\t_, err := Load(writeFile(t, content))\n\tvar reject *RejectError\n\tif !errors.As(err, &reject) {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"Load(%q) error = %v, want *RejectError\", content, err)\n\t}\n\treturn reject\n}\n\nfunc TestTrimHeaderNames(t *testing.T) {\n\ttable, err := Load(writeFile(t, \"  alpha , beta  \\n1,2\\n\"))\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\tt.Fatal(err)\n\t}\n\twant := []string{\"alpha\", \"beta\"}\n\tif !reflect.DeepEqual(table.Header, want) {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"Header = %q, want %q\", table.Header, want)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestTrimValues(t *testing.T) {\n\ttable, err := Load(writeFile(t, \"a,b\\n  x ,\\t y \\n\"))\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\tt.Fatal(err)\n\t}\n\tif got, want := table.Column(0), []string{\"x\"}; !reflect.DeepEqual(got, want) {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"column a = %q, want %q\", got, want)\n\t}\n\tif got, want := table.Column(1), []string{\"\\t y \\t\"[0:0] + \"\\t y \"}; !reflect.DeepEqual(got, want) {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"column b = %q, want %q (tabs are not trimmed)\", got, want)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestRejectEmptyFile(t *testing.T) {\n\tfor _, content := range []string{\"\", \"\\n\"} {\n\t\treject := loadRejected(t, content)\n\t\tif reject.Line != 0 {\n\t\t\tt.Errorf(\"Load(%q) line = %d, want 0 for a whole-file rejection\", content, reject.Line)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestRejectBadHeader(t *testing.T) {\n\tcases := map[string]int{\n\t\t\",b\\n1,2\\n\":   1, // empty name\n\t\t\"a,a\\n1,2\\n\":  1, // repeated\n\t\t\"a, a\\n1,2\\n\": 1, // repeated only after trimming\n\t\t\"a, \\n1,2\\n\":  1, // empty only after trimming\n\t}\n\tfor content, line := range cases {\n\t\treject := loadRejected(t, content)\n\t\tif reject.Line != line {\n\t\t\tt.Errorf(\"Load(%q) line = %d, want %d\", content, reject.Line, line)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestRejectRaggedRecord(t *testing.T) {\n\tcases := map[string]int{\n\t\t\"a,b\\n1\\n\":        2, // short\n\t\t\"a,b\\n1,2,3\\n\":    2, // long\n\t\t\"a,b\\n1,2\\n3,4,5\": 3, // later line\n\t}\n\tfor content, line := range cases {\n\t\treject := loadRejected(t, content)\n\t\tif reject.Line != line {\n\t\t\tt.Errorf(\"Load(%q) line = %d, want %d\", content, reject.Line, line)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestRejectCSVSyntaxError(t *testing.T) {\n\treject := loadRejected(t, \"a,b\\n1,x\\\"y\\n\")\n\tif reject.Line != 2 {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"line = %d, want 2\", reject.Line)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestHeaderOnlyFileIsValid(t *testing.T) {\n\ttable, err := Load(writeFile(t, \"sku,price\\n\"))\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\tt.Fatal(err)\n\t}\n\tif len(table.Records) != 0 {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"Records = %d, want 0\", len(table.Records))\n\t}\n\tif want := []string{\"sku\", \"price\"}; err != nil {\n\t\tt.Fatal(err)\n\t}\n\treturn path\n}\n\n// loadRejected loads content and asserts it is rejected with a RejectError, returning that error.\nfunc loadRejected(t *testing.T, content string) *RejectError {\n\tt.Helper()\n\t_, err := Load(writeFile(t, content))\n\tvar reject *RejectError\n\tif !errors.As(err, &reject) {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"Load(%q) error = %v, want *RejectError\", content, err)\n\t}\n\treturn reject\n}\n\nfunc TestTrimHeaderNames(t *testing.T) {\n\ttable, err := Load(writeFile(t, \"  alpha , beta  \\n1,2\\n\"))\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\tt.Fatal(err)\n\t}\n\twant := []string{\"alpha\", \"beta\"}\n\tif !reflect.DeepEqual(table.Header, want) {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"Header = %q, want %q\", table.Header, want)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestTrimValues(t *testing.T) {\n\ttable, err := Load(writeFile(t, \"a,b\\n  x ,\\t y \\n\"))\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\tt.Fatal(err)\n\t}\n\tif got, want := table.Column(0), []string{\"x\"}; !reflect.DeepEqual(got, want) {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"column a = %q, want %q\", got, want)\n\t}\n\tif got, want := table.Column(1), []string{\"\\t y \\t\"[0:0] + \"\\t y \"}; !reflect.DeepEqual(got, want) {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"column b = %q, want %q (tabs are not trimmed)\", got, want)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestRejectEmptyFile(t *testing.T) {\n\tfor _, content := range []string{\"\", \"\\n\"} {\n\t\treject := loadRejected(t, content)\n\t\tif reject.Line != 0 {\n\t\t\tt.Errorf(\"Load(%q) line = %d, want 0 for a whole-file rejection\", content, reject.Line)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestRejectBadHeader(t *testing.T) {\n\tcases := map[string]int{\n\t\t\",b\\n1,2\\n\":   1, // empty name\n\t\t\"a,a\\n1,2\\n\":  1, // repeated\n\t\t\"a, a\\n1,2\\n\": 1, // repeated only after trimming\n\t\t\"a, \\n1,2\\n\":  1, // empty only after trimming\n\t}\n\tfor content, line := range cases {\n\t\treject := loadRejected(t, content)\n\t\tif reject.Line != line {\n\t\t\tt.Errorf(\"Load(%q) line = %d, want %d\", content, reject.Line, line)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestRejectRaggedRecord(t *testing.T) {\n\tcases := map[string]int{\n\t\t\"a,b\\n1\\n\":        2, // short\n\t\t\"a,b\\n1,2,3\\n\":    2, // long\n\t\t\"a,b\\n1,2\\n3,4,5\": 3, // later line\n\t}\n\tfor content, line := range cases {\n\t\treject := loadRejected(t, content)\n\t\tif reject.Line != line {\n\t\t\tt.Errorf(\"Load(%q) line = %d, want %d\", content, reject.Line, line)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestRejectCSVSyntaxError(t *testing.T) {\n\treject := loadRejected(t, \"a,b\\n1,x\\\"y\\n\")\n\tif reject.Line != 2 {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"line = %d, want 2\", reject.Line)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestHeaderOnlyFileIsValid(t *testing.T) {\n\ttable, err := Load(writeFile(t, \"sku,price\\n\"))\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\tt.Fatal(err)\n\t}\n\tif len(table.Records) != 0 {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"Records = %d, want 0\", len(table.Records))\n\t}\n\tif want := []string{\"sku\", \"price\"}; !reflect.DeepEqual(table.Header, want) {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"Header = %q, want %q\", table.Header, want)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestByteOrderMarkIsKept(t *testing.T) {\n\tconst bom = \"﻿\"\n\ttable, err := Load(writeFile(t, bom+\"a,b\\n1,2\\n\"))\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\tt.Fatal(err)\n\t}\n\tif table.Header[0] != bom+\"a\" {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"first header = %q, want BOM kept\", table.Header[0])\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestInvalidUTF8IsNotRejected(t *testing.T) {\n\tif _, err := Load(writeFile(t, \"a,b\\n\\xff,2\\n\")); err != nil {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"Load() error = %v, want nil\", err)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestQuotedCommaIsOneValue(t *testing.T) {\n\ttable, err := Load(writeFile(t, \"a,b\\n\\\"x, y\\\",2\\n\"))\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\tt.Fatal(err)\n\t}\n\tif got := table.Column(0)[0]; got != \"x, y\" {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"value = %q, want %q\", got, \"x, y\")\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestUnreadablePathIsReadError(t *testing.T) {\n\t_, err := Load(filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), \"missing.csv\"))\n\tvar read *ReadError\n\tif !errors.As(err, &read) {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"Load(missing) error = %v, want *ReadError\", err)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestDirectoryIsReadError(t *testing.T) {\n\t_, err := Load(t.TempDir())\n\tvar read *ReadError\n\tif !errors.As(err, &read) {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"Load(directory) error = %v, want *ReadError\", err)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestIndexIsExactAndCaseSensitive(t *testing.T) {\n\ttable, err := Load(writeFile(t, \"Alpha,beta\\n1,2\\n\"))\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\tt.Fatal(err)\n\t}\n\tif i, ok := table.Index(\"beta\"); {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-haiku-5-5","id":"msg_011CgN1y3LsfLd1a2pXdvNgp","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_017XWzU3xLPJ9xuPPrMnkFMk","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/mnt/c/Users/barlo/projects/drydock/uat/CsvStat/runs/20261025.001433/build/CsvStat/internal/decimal/decimal_test.go","content":"package decimal\n\nimport (\n\t\"math/big\"\n\t\"testing\"\n)\n\nfunc rat(t *testing.T, s string) *big.Rat {\n\tt.Helper()\n\tr, ok := new(big.Rat).SetString(s)\n\tif !ok {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"bad rational literal %q\", s)\n\t}\n\treturn r\n}\n\nfunc TestFormatTwoDecimals(t *testing.T) {\n\tcases := map[string]string{\n\t\t\"3\":          \"3.00\",\n\t\t\"0\":          \"0.00\",\n\t\t\"1234567.89\": \"1234567.89\",\n\t\t\"0.5\":        \"0.50\",\n\t\t\"-3\":         \"-3.00\",\n\t\t\"100.1\":      \"100.10\",\n\t}\n\tfor in, want := range cases {\n\t\tif got := Format(rat(t, in)); got != want {\n\t\t\tt.Errorf(\"Format(%s) = %q, want %q\", in, got, want)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestFormatRoundsHalfAwayFromZeroOnce(t *testing.T) {\n\tcases := map[string]string{\n\t\t\"2.675\":   \"2.68\", // exact tie rounds up\n\t\t\"-2.675\":  \"-2.68\", // exact tie rounds away from zero\n\t\t\"1.255\":   \"1.26\",\n\t\t\"0.005\":   \"0.01\",\n\t\t\"-0.005\":  \"-0.01\",\n\t\t\"1.0049\":  \"1.00\",\n\t\t\"2.674\":   \"2.67\",\n\t\t\"1/3\":     \"0.33\",\n\t\t\"-2/3\":    \"-0.67\",\n\t\t\"9.995\":   \"10.00\",\n\t\t\"-9.995\":  \"-10.00\",\n\t\t\"0.00499\": \"0.00\",\n\t}\n\tfor in, want := range cases {\n\t\tif got := Format(rat(t, in)); got != want {\n\t\t\tt.Errorf(\"Format(%s) = %q, want %q\", in, got, want)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestFormatNegativeZeroHasNoSign(t *testing.T) {\n\tfor _, in := range []string{\"-0.001\", \"-0.004\", \"-0\"} {\n\t\tif got := Format(rat(t, in)); {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-haiku-5-5","id":"msg_011CgN1zcWSLcVBdXKHSrpw4","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01Bt1F6EXSSdp7eixm9AztX6","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/mnt/c/Users/barlo/projects/drydock/uat/CsvStat/runs/20261025.001433/build/CsvStat/internal/cli/cli_test.go","content":"package cli\n\nimport (\n\t\"bytes\"\n\t\"encoding/csv\"\n\t\"os\"\n\t\"path/filepath\"\n\t\"reflect\"\n\t\"strings\"\n\t\"testing\"\n)\n\n// writeCSV stores content in a fresh temporary file and returns its path.\nfunc writeCSV(t *testing.T, content string) string {\n\tt.Helper()\n\tpath := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), \"in.csv\")\n\tif err := os.WriteFile(path, []byte(content), 0o644); err != nil {\n\t\tt.Fatal(err)\n\t}\n\treturn path\n}\n\n// parseRecords reads stdout back as CSV so tests compare values, not text.\nfunc parseRecords(t *testing.T, out string) [][]string {\n\tt.Helper()\n\trecords, err := csv.NewReader(strings.NewReader(out)).ReadAll()\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"stdout is not CSV: %v\\n%s\", err, out)\n\t}\n\treturn records\n}\n\nfunc TestRunExitCodes(t *testing.T) {\n\tgood := writeCSV(t, \"a,b\\n1,2\\n\")\n\tragged := writeCSV(t, \"a,b\\n1\\n\")\n\ttests := []struct {\n\t\tname string\n\t\targs []string\n\t\twant int\n\t}{\n\t\t{name: \"no arguments\", args: nil, want: exitUsage},\n\t\t{name: \"two files\", args: []string{good, good}, want: exitUsage},\n\t\t{name: \"unknown flag\", args: []string{\"--no-such-flag\", good}, want: exitUsage},\n\t\t{name: \"help flag\", args: []string{\"--help\"}, want: exitOK},\n\t\t{name: \"profile one file\", args: []string{good}, want: exitOK},\n\t\t{name: \"unreadable file\", args: []string{filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), \"missing.csv\")}, want: exitRead},\n\t\t{name: \"directory\", args: []string{t.TempDir()}, want: exitRead},\n\t\t{name: \"ragged file\", args: []string{ragged}, want: exitReject},\n\t\t{name: \"absent column\", args: []string{\"--column\", \"zz\", good}, want: exitReject},\n\t\t{name: \"absent freq name\", args: []string{\"--freq\", \"zz\", good}, want: exitReject},\n\t\t{name: \"usage before file access\", args: []string{\"--top\", \"3\", \"missing.csv\"}, want: exitUsage},\n\t}\n\tfor _, tt := range tests {\n\t\tt.Run(tt.name, func(t *testing.T) {\n\t\t\tvar stdout, stderr bytes.Buffer\n\t\t\tif got := Run(tt.args, &stdout, &stderr); got != tt.want {\n\t\t\t\tt.Errorf(\"Run(%q) = %d, want %d (stderr %q)\", tt.args, got, tt.want, stderr.String())\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t})\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestRunWritesNothingToStdoutOnFailure(t *testing.T) {\n\tragged := writeCSV(t, \"a,b\\n1\\n\")\n\tcases := [][]string{\n\t\tnil,\n\t\t{\"--frobnicate\", ragged},\n\t\t{filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), \"missing.csv\")},\n\t\t{ragged},\n\t\t{\"--column\", \"zz\", writeCSV(t, \"a\\n1\\n\")},\n\t}\n\tfor _, args := range cases {\n\t\tvar stdout, stderr bytes.Buffer\n\t\tif code := Run(args, &stdout, &stderr); code == exitOK {\n\t\t\tt.Fatalf(\"Run(%q) = 0, want a failure\", args)\n\t\t}\n\t\tif stdout.Len() != 0 {\n\t\t\tt.Errorf(\"Run(%q) stdout = %q, want empty\", args, stdout.String())\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestRunHelpWritesUsageToStdoutOnly(t *testing.T) {\n\tvar stdout, stderr bytes.Buffer\n\tif code := Run([]string{\"--help\"}, &stdout, &stderr); code != exitOK {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"Run(--help) = %d, want 0\", code)\n\t}\n\tif stderr.Len() != 0 {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"stderr = %q, want empty\", stderr.String())\n\t}\n\tfor _, token := range []string{\"csvstat\", \"--column\", \"--freq\", \"--top\", \"--help\"} {\n\t\tif !strings.Contains(stdout.String(), token) {\n\t\t\tt.Errorf(\"usage does not name %q\", token)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestRunProfilesEveryColumnInFileOrder(t *testing.T) {\n\tpath := writeCSV(t, \" id , name \\n1, Ada \\n2,NA\\n\")\n\tvar stdout, stderr bytes.Buffer\n\tif code := Run([]string{path}, &stdout, &stderr); code != exitOK {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"Run() = %d, stderr %q\", code, stderr.String())\n\t}\n\trecords := parseRecords(t, stdout.String())\n\twant := [][]string{\n\t\t{\"column\", \"type\", \"rows\", \"nulls\", \"distinct\", \"min\", \"max\", \"sum\", \"mean\", \"median\"},\n\t\t{\"id\", \"integer\", \"2\", \"0\", \"2\", \"1\", \"2\", \"3\", \"1.50\", \"1.50\"},\n\t\t{\"name\", \"text\", \"2\", \"1\", \"1\", \"Ada\", \"Ada\", \"\", \"\", \"\"},\n\t}\n\tif !reflect.DeepEqual(records, want) {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"profile = %q, want %q\", records, want)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestRunProfileSingleColumn(t *testing.T) {\n\tpath := writeCSV(t, \"a,b\\n1,x\\n2,y\\n\")\n\tvar stdout, stderr bytes.Buffer\n\tif code := Run([]string{\"--column\", \"b\", path}, &stdout, &stderr); code != exitOK {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"Run() = %d, stderr %q\", code, stderr.String())\n\t}\n\trecords := parseRecords(t, stdout.String())\n\tif len(records) != 2 || records[1][0] != \"b\" {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"records = %q, want header plus the b row\", records)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestRunFrequencyListsAndLimits(t *testing.T) {\n\tpath := writeCSV(t, \"s\\nnorth\\nsouth\\nnorth\\neast\\nNA\\nsouth\\nnorth\\n\")\n\tvar stdout, stderr bytes.Buffer\n\tif code := Run([]string{\"--freq\", \"s\", \"--top\", \"2\", path}, &stdout, &stderr); code != exitOK {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"Run() = %d, stderr %q\", code, stderr.String())\n\t}\n\trecords := parseRecords(t, stdout.String())\n\twant := [][]string{{\"value\", \"count\"}, {\"north\", \"3\"}, {\"south\", \"2\"}}\n\tif !reflect.DeepEqual(records, want) {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"frequencies = %q, want %q\", records, want)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestRunFrequencyDefaultLimitIsFive(t *testing.T) {\n\tpath := writeCSV(t, \"s\\na\\nb\\nc\\nd\\ne\\nf\\ng\\n\")\n\tvar stdout, stderr bytes.Buffer\n\tif code := Run([]string{\"--freq\", \"s\", path}, &stdout, &stderr); code != exitOK {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"Run() = %d, stderr %q\", code, stderr.String())\n\t}\n\tif got := len(parseRecords(t, stdout.String())) - 1; got != 5 {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"rows = %d, want 5\", got)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestRunFrequencyAllNullWritesHeaderOnly(t *testing.T) {\n\tpath := writeCSV(t, \"s,b\\n1,\\n2,NA\\n\")\n\tvar stdout, stderr bytes.Buffer\n\tif code := Run([]string{\"--freq\", \"b\", path}, &stdout, &stderr);
